ada.text: Hello, neighbours! I keep bees, so I spend a lot of time among the apple trees in spring. When the blossoms open, my bees work them from dawn, and that is why the autumn apples come out so sweet. A good orchard and a good hive need each other, and I love tending both.

bo.text: Um… hi. The pond is quiet in the morning, mostly. I play music near it sometimes, soft things, because the water seems to listen. I think it's the nicest place here.
